Commentary.Commentary: Boult was the first one to pick a wicket this morning, joined by Wagner and later it was Sodhi who whipped off the tail. A special knock by Craig Ervine of 146 was the stand out performance for the home side. They couldn't surpass the marginal follow-on tally but it won't be an issue as New Zealand lead by 220 runs and are coming in to bat just before lunch to set a target for Zimbabwe. Join us in a bit for the New Zealand's reply.

The hosts have finally been bowled out. After having a great day yesterday with the bat, they would have liked to score more runs. The Kiwi bowlers came out today with a positive intent and picked up wickets at a regular intervals.

The ball goes to long off, where Wagner takes a simple catch. After all that efforts and scoring a maiden test century, gets out on 146! The hosts are bowled out on 362!

On the pads, flicked away to the leg side for a single.

It is a beautiful day at Bulawayo and the atmosphere is playable as of now. The players and the umpires are out in the field. The two overnight batsmen are at the crease. Graeme Cremer to take strike. Trent Boult to bowl. Here we go...

The question is can New Zealand turn around their course of action with the ball and wrap up the innings of Zimbabwe? Or will it be yet another day of Rhodesians with the bat. The conditions as of now show clouds hovering and it is pretty cold out there too. Hopefully it should be fine. Do join us in a bit for the same.

Hello and greetings to everyone. We are on day 4 and Zimbabwe are still battling out there in response to the Kiwis' 582. The home side is on 305/6 and are looking strong to avoid the follow-on and then lessen the deficit to as low as possible. Craig Ervine, the centurion and Graeme Cremer, the skipper would want to keep the fight going.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

Craig Ervine and the home side skipper managed to see off the day well and will look to surpass the follow-on mark of 78 before they think about the actual trail. The Kiwi bowlers were good in the first half but since then they were hapless and ineffective apart from a wicket of Peter Moor towards the end of the day. Will it be a resistant Zimbabwe with the bat tomorrow? Or will it be the high-flying Kiwis with the ball? Do join us to find out. Until then, take care and goodbye!

That will end the session pretty much in the bag of Zimbabwe as they were all merry today with runs.  After being on 185/5 at Tea, the hosts went on to make 305/6 and saw off the day. The duo of Craig Ervine and Peter Moor was fluent and played magnificently in the middle to score as many runs as possible. The former went on to make a maiden Test century and the latter scored a half century and that too on debut. The two also stitched the highest 6th wicket partnership for Zimbabwe since Jan 2005 and just then Peter departed after his well-constructed 71.

Short of a length, angling across the batsman. Steers towards the man at gully.
Tad short and down the leg, Ervine pulls it through fine leg for a single.
FOUR! So easy for Craig! It's an overpitched delivery on the stumps, Ervine lunges forward and bunts it down the ground presenting the full face of the bat for a boundary. That was a classy stroke!
Full and angling in, Ervine defends it well towards the off side.
NEIL WAGNER is brought back into the attack!
FOUR! Bad delivery, put away! Full toss on the pads, PM flicks it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. Poor bowling by Santner.
Full delivery, driven straight back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pitched outside off, Moor looks to play across the line. The ball doesn't spin as much as he thinks but gets beaten past his inside edge.
Moor plants his front food ahead and defends.
OUCH! Tossed up outside off, Moor drives it powerfully but hits the legs of the man at silly point. That must have hurt.
MITCHELL SANTNER replaces Trent Boult.
Full and very wide outside off, left alone.
Drifting down leg, Ervine looks to flick it off the pads but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Banged in short, Ervine ducks to evade it.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.

FOUR! Raining boundaries in the stadium! Short delivery on leg, angling across, Ervine pulls it through  the leg side behind square. Boult from square leg runs in and dives whereas Sodhi from fine leg comes in and tries to stop by his foot. Both aren't successful and the ball races dwon the fence.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! What a shot! Full and wide outside off, Moor slashes it through point for a boundary. Three boundaries in an over. Attacking mode on!
Drifting down leg, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery, Ervine defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Flicked away! Full on the pads, CE flicks it off his pads for a boundary. Ervine getting on the top of the New Zealand bowlers.
FOUR! Driven! Full ball on off, Ervine drives it straight down the ground for a spectacular boundary. Top stuff from Ervine.
Angling down leg, Ervine looks to flicks it but misses and gets hit on the pads.
tad short delivery, punched off the back foot to mid-wicket.
On the pads, worked towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Well adjusted! Touch back of a length, Ervine hops form within the crease and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. That brings up the 50-run partnership for Ervine and Moor.
Length delivery, angling across, defended off the back foot.
Bouncer! Ervine lets it go.
FOUR! That's some shot! Full and wide outside off, Ervine drives through covers beautifully for a boundary. Ervine is looking good out in the middle.
Banged in short, Moor ducks to evade it.
Second Test fifty for Craig Ervine!
Full angling down the leg side, flicked nicely through the mid-wicket region for a single. This brings up 50 for Craig Ervine.
Length delivery angling on the pads, Ervine defends it within the crease.
Pitched on a good length around off, Moor watches the ball closely and then pushes it through covers for three runs.
Length delivery outside off, defended to point.
Short delivery angling down leg, pulled away to deep backward square leg for a single.
Players are back in the middle after their Tea break. Peter Moor and Craig Ervine will continue to bat. Trent Boult will start off the proceedings of the last session of the day.
... DAY 3, SESSION 3 ...

Since then Craig Ervine and Peter Moor played well to not cause any more casualties for their side. The stand between them is 48 now. They will look to strengthen their partnership and see the day off.  On the other hand, the Kiwi bowlers will like to bowl out the opposition to end the day on a high note. Do join us in a bit for the final session.

The hosts have slipped further from 107/3 to 185/5! Zimbabwe lost Chamu Chibhabha just before lunch and Prince Masauvre too got out straightaway in the second session. Credit goes to Mitchell Santner for removing both of them. Sean Williams and Craig Ervine played well in the middle and kept the scoreboard ticking. Ish Sodhi with his flighted ball caught Williams on the pads off his reverse sweep for him to depart.
Length delivery outside off, this time closer to the stumps, defended towards backward point from within the crease. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 3!
MISSED OUT THIS TIME! Short and wide outside off, Moor looks to cut it again but doesn't time it well and the ball catches the bottom edge into the ground.
FOUR! SLASHED HARD! Wide outside off, Moor leans down a little and cuts it past backward point fielder for a boundary. Poor line by Tim Southee.
Length delivery outside off, Moor pushes it through the gap in the cover region for a brace.
Pitched on middle, angling down leg, worked to mid-wicket.
Banged in short outside off from Southee, Moor leans backwards to avoid it.
Pitched on a good length outside off, Moor looks to push it on the off side but gets an inside edge towards the leg side for a single.
Bouncer! Moor ducks to evade it.
Angling down leg, clipped off his pads through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Angling in from outside off, CE defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full outside off, defended off the front foot.
Length delivery around off, Ervine looks to defend it off the back foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
TRENT BOULT is back into the attack.
Drifting down leg, Moor flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! THAT'S A BEAUTY! Full and wide outside off, slashed through backward point for a superb boundary.
FOUR! HARD LUCK SOUTHEE! Pitched just outside off, PM looks to defend it away from his body from within the crease but gets a thick inside edge towards the fine leg boundary.
Outside off, Moor offers no shot.
Full on the pads, clipped away through square leg for a single.
Pitched on off, shaping in after pitching, defended off the front foot towards mid on.
SECOND NEW BALL TAKEN! TIM SOUTHEE will start the proceedings with the new ball.
Pitched outside off, Moor watches it carefully, gets a big front foot ahead and leaves it.
Tossed up around middle and off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Full delivery, driven through mid off for a single.
Arm ball, drifting down leg, Moor looks to flick it but misses.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Ervine sweeps the ball on the full to square leg for a single.
Moor gets down the track, Sodhi sees him coming and bowls a short leg-spinner. The ball bounces off the turf which surprises Moor but he manages well to keep it down.
Short deliver, Moor stays back in his crease and pulls it away behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Drifting down leg, Ervine works it nicely towards the leg side for a single.
On middle and leg, CE defends it from within the crease.
Full toss outside off, driven through covers for couple. Boult at mid off misfields and gives away free runs.
Pitched outside leg, spinning into the pads of the batsman, defended watchfully by Ervine.
Outside off, spinning away, Moor lets it go.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle and off, driven to covers.
Pitched on leg, defended by a straight bat.
Ervine gets down on one knee and sweeps it on the full towards square leg for a single.
Pitched around off, turning into the batsman, Ervine defends it off the back foot.
Pitched around off, spinning away, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, Moor offers no shot.
Moor plants ahead a firm front foot and the defends.
Pitched on middle and leg, blocked it late from within the crease.
Tossed up around middle and off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Loopy full outside off, driven in the cover region.
The second new ball is available now.
Flighted delivery, efended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Ervine gets back in his crease, lets the ball come to him and then defends.
Loopy delivery outside off, Ervine leans forward and defends it.
Full outside off, blocked off the front foot.
Pitched around off, turns in sharply, CR manages well to defend it on the leg side.
Outside off, left alone by Ervine.
MITCHELL SANTNER is back on.
Another flat delivery outside off, blocked out.
FOUR! A mandatory Ish Sodhi half-tracker! It's around off, Moor rocks back and positions himself well, pulls it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Bowls this slower through the air, some nice flight given to it as well, PM gets behind the line and buries it into the ground ahead.
Floats this one up just around off, Peter, keeping his bat and pad real close presents a tight defensive shot.
Full outside off, pushed a little quicker through the air, tapped to the off side.
Tossed up delivery outside off, maybe a little too full, Moor drives this straight to covers.
Good length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Another full ball fired in on off, it's coming in again as the southpaw is going for the drive. Gets it off the inside half of the bat towards mid on.
Yorker fired in on middle and off, swinging in heavily too, Ervine does well to keep it at bay. Well played.
Fullish delivery which is well outside off, Ervine from deep in his crease, opens the face and plays it towards point for a run.
Full on the stumps, it's turned to square leg for one easy run.
On a good length and outside off, Craig punches this to covers. No run taken.
Driven through covers once more to end the over.
Outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Loopy and full outside off, driven to covers for no run.
Drags the length back this time, outside off, Ervine gets back and dabs it to point for one run.

That was a close one. Flatter on middle, Moor looks to block it out but the ball goes off the inside edge down to fine leg. He's having a real had time against the leggie. One run taken by the batsmen.
Flat on middle stump, it's full in length and driven down to long on for a single.
Looped up outside off, left alone for the keeper to gobble up.
Flatter and shorter on middle and off, pulled to deep square leg. One run taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Another fuller ball which is angling down, Craig is eyeing to flick it away but the ball brushes his pads. Watling shuffles across and dives to catch it and instantly goes up in an appeal. The umpire isn't too bothered with it.
Full and fired in on middle and off, angling in, kept out well off the front foot.
Wagner comes charging in, bowls a fullish delivery going down the leg side, Ervine looks to flick it away but it goes off the pads and into the keeper's gloves.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Moor is unable to pick up the googly. Been causing him problems. It's pitched around off, Moor comes forward and looks to defend it. Is rapped on the pads as an appeal goes up. The umpire just shakes his head.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, blocked off the front foot and into the track.

Drags the length back on this and pitches it around off, it's a googly and it comes back in sharply, Moor rocks back and looks to play at it but misses as the ball goes off the thigh pad and into the hands of first slip. Sodhi appeals for a caught behind but the umpire isn't interested.
Floated up on middle and off, Moor prods forward and blocks it out.
PETER MOOR is the next batsman in.

OUT! SODHI STRIKES! Excellent tossed up leg spinner on off, Williams kneels down and looks to reverse sweep this away but misses. He is rapped on the pads and there are roaring appeals for a leg before. The umpire takes him time, contemplates long and hard and then raises his finger. The hero of Zimbabwe's first Test is now back in the pavilion.
Fuller and angled across, outside off, it's driven through the covers for three runs. Was nicely timed and hit well between the gap.
FOUR! Keeps it on the shorter side once more, Williams is up for this one, though. Leans back and superbly upper cuts it over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Changing it up here, fires in a yorker on middle and off, equally well kept out by the southpaw.
Another bouncer from Wagner, it's slower in pace and outside off, Williams thinks of pulling it away but decides to withdraw at the last second.
Bangs this one in short once again, Sean looks to ride the bounce and pull it away but doesn't quite get a hold of it as he hits it towards square leg.
Wagner comes from around the wicket to the left-hander, bangs in short first up. Williams does well to duck and evade.
Drinks time!
Flatter one on middle, Ervine defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Craig has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around middle, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball around middle, Ervine defends it gently.
Wagner once again bowls a short ball, Williams once again does what he has been doing.
Another bumper on off, Ervine is happy to duck under it.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Banged short on middle, Ervine ducks to evade it.
Another short ball on middle, didn't rise well. Williams looks to pull but misses.
Short of a length delivery, from around the wicket. The batsman ducks to evade it.
Quicker one on the pads, nudged towards square leg for a single.
Bowls a slider down the leg side, swept behind square on the leg side for one.
Floated ball around off, defended off the front foot gently.
Flighted ball around off, pushed towards covers.
Loopy ball around leg, flicked towards short leg.
Loopy ball around middle, Ervine punches it back to the bowler.
Fuller and angled on the pads, the batsman comes across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length and outside off, Ervine has got nothing to offer on that one.
That was close! On a length and curling in as well. Ervine looks to drive but the ball goes just under his bat towards the keeper.
Outside off, left alone again.
On a length and outside off, Ervine shoulders his arms.
Defended watchfully towards the off side.
Drops it short on middle, it's pulled towards square leg for a single.
On middle and leg, defended towards short leg.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Comes from around the wicket and loops it around middle. Ervine defends it down.

FOUR! Divine stuff form Ervine! Santner bowls a loopy ball around off, Ervine reads it early, gets into the position and reverse sweeps it through backward point for a boundary. He tried playing a similar shot in Santner's last over but found the man that time. This time he gets the desired result.
Bangs it short on middle, Williams ducks to evade it. Wagner is bowling really well here, making the batsman think everything he delivers.
Bowls it short and outside off, at 141 kph. It sat at a nice height and that is why Williams went for the pull. He misses it completely.
Fuller on off, defended towards the man at covers.
Short of a length delivery, at 139 kph, Williams has got nothing to do with that one.
Fuller on off, slightly shaping away. SW presses forward and defends it towards the right of the bowler.
Good length delivery on off, Williams defends it off the back foot.
Loopy ball around off, reverse swept past the man at short third man for a single to keep strike.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Swept away in disdain! Tossed up around middle, Ervine gets down on one knee and sweeps it off the meat of the bat towards square leg for a boundary. No need to run for those.
Full and around off, Ervine looks to drive but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Loopy ball around off, turning in. Clipped towards square leg for a single.
Loopy ball around middle, comes forward and flicks it towards short leg.
Intentionally done! On a length and outside off, Williams gets forward, opens the face of the bat and guides it through gully for a couple. Williamson does well to save a couple.
Pitches it up and outside off, Williams gets forward and drives it straight to covers.
Good length delivery on off, Sean offers a back foot defense.
Gets right behind the line of the delivery and defends it down.
Williams tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side.
Fuller ball and tailing in, Williams looks to flick but misses.
NEIL WAGNER is back into the attack!
FOUR! Drilled! Loopy delivery around off, Ervine lunges forward and drives it through covers for a boundary. He was admiring his shot as well.
Drags his length back, turns in a bit. Ervine tucks it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Drops it short on middle, whipped through mid-wicket for another single.
Craig gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards square leg for one.
Flatter one on the pads, Ervine flicks it towards the leg side.
Loopy ball around off, Ervine comes forward and makes a watchful leave.

Full and fired down the leg side, Williams looks to flick it down the leg side but misses. Watling dives to his left and collects it. Replays show it cameo off the bat and had the keeper taken it, Williams would have been a goner.
Fuller on off, Williams pushes it towards the off side.
Tad short on middle, pulled towards mid-wicket for a single.
In the channel outside off, the batsman shoulders his arms to that one.
Short of a length delivery on off, it's fended away on the off side.
Good length delivery on middle, defended towards covers off the back foot.
On middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards point.
SEAN WILLIAMS, the star of the first Test for Zimbabwe walks in next!

OUT! Prince has dragged it on, a tame dismissal that. Santner bowls a loopy ball around off, Masvaure gets back to defend but the ball goes off the toe end of the bat, bounces down and goes back to hit the leg pole. The bails are off and Masvaure tries to shoo it away but is late to do so. He walks back with a forlorn face and Zimbabwe still trail by 467 runs.
Tossed up around middle and leg, the batsman looks to flick but misses and a good take by Watling behind.
Flatter one around middle, defended with a straight bat.
In the channel outside off, Ervine shoulders his arms to that one.
Excellent bowling! Yorker fired on the stumps, Masvaure looks to dig it out but gets an inside edge through the legs towards fine leg. A run taken.
Banged short on middle and leg, Masvaure ducks to evade it.
Angles a length delivery on the pads, flicked towards the leg side.
On a length and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Fuller length delivery on off, pushed past the non-striker for a quick single.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Loopy ball around middle and off, PM lunges forward and keeps it out.
On middle and leg, Masvaure defends it gently.
Full and around off, Masvaure defends it down.
Comes down the track and works it down to long on for a single.

Slider around leg, swept towards the on side where the short leg fielder does well to stop it. Ervine was outside the crease and the fielder back-flicks it on the stumps. Luckily, it didn't hit otherwise it would have been close.
Fuller length ball outside off, defended strongly off the front foot and back to the bowler.
On a good length delivery outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Gets behind the line and defends it nicely.
Tad full and moving away a bit. Prince gets forward to defend but gets an outside edge towards the slip cordon. No damage done.
Fuller length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
NShort of a length delivery outside off, Masvaure shoulders his arms.
Slider around leg, flicked towards the leg side for no runs.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Full and around middle, Masvaure prods forward and keeps it out.
Tossed up around middle, defended off the front foot.

A loud shout for lbw, turned down! On a length and nipping in sharply. Ervine gets forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. There were two noises and the umpire turns it down. Replays show there was an inside edge. Height was an issue as well.

FOUR! Wristy work from Craig! Boult keeps it full and it's too straight as well. Ervine moves across and flicks it through mid-wicket past the diving fielder for a boundary. Sheer timing on that occasion.
On a length and tad full as well. Gets it to curl in a bit Ervine trusts the bounce and leaves it alone.
Fuller length delivery on middle, defended off the front foot.
Angles a full length delivery on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Watling now goes back again...
On a length and around off, Ervine goes back to defend but the ball just whizzes past the outside edge.
TRENT BOULT will bowl from the other end! The keeper is up as well...
Floated ball around off, Masvaure looks to drive it through the off side but it goes off the inner part of the bat towards mid on.
Full and around middle, Masvaure pushes it back to Santner.
Tossed up around off, defended watchfully by the batsman.
Loopy ball around off, Pricne lunges forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Welcome back for the afternoon session! Craig Ervine will now be joined by Prince Masvaure. Mitchell Santner will complete his pending over... Let's play...
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

Chamu Chibhabha was the lone warrior in the hosts' attempt to reach the impossible total of New Zealand and was doing good until he got out off Santner's ball just before lunch. The Kiwis will look to bowl out the home side in the second session and then it would be interesting to see if they will bat again or will they enforce the follow-on. We hope the Rhodesians show some fight against this high quality bowling. Join us in a bit for the post-Lunch session.

After toiling hard in the final session on Day 2, New Zealand have finally managed to pick up some wickets and to be precise its 3. After a long delay for the first breakthrough, they did exceptionally by bowling in the right areas. Southee was the first one to pick up a wicket followed by Wagner and Santner. To be frank, the fielding of the visitors was top notch as well barring Taylor's poor effort which could have seen Ervine depart.

OUT! In the air... caught! Double C you gotta go! Kane Willamson, you freaking beauty! What a catch, that! Santner gives this a bit more flight and bowls it around off. Chibhabha lunges forward to drive but ends up playing it a bit too uppishly. The birthday boy stationed at short covers dives full length to his left and gobbles it pretty well. After fighting hard Chibhabha has to make his way back. That's also Lunch on day 3!
Full and around off, defended fof the front foot.
Loopy ball around off, defended watchfully.
On middle and leg, driven towards the man at mid on.
Tossed up around middle and off, defended again watchfully.
Loopy ball around middle, turns in as well. Ervine prods forward and defends it down. That is the line where Ish needs to bowl.

FOUR! Too short from Sodhi and gets the treatment! Half-tracker on middle, Ervine camps back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. That was the problem with him on day 2 as well, too many short balls he bowled.
Loopy ball around middle, turning in. Ervine gets back to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
ISH SODHI is introduced into the attack.
Another loopy ball on off, blocked watchfully.
Serves it on off, a bit of flight on it. Chamu off his front foot defends it.
Loopy ball on off, pushed to covers.
Floats it up on middle and off, Chamu plays it to covers.
Flights it on off, Chamu off his front foot pushes it to covers.
Tossed ball on middle and leg, Ervine pushes it to mid on for a run.
Mitchell Santner will bowl next.
Short ball on middle and leg, Chamu tries to pull that away but gets hit on his rib cage. Some nasty blow there for him. End of the over.
Bouncer on middle and leg, Chamu ducks in time to let that through.
Back of a length ball on off, Chibhabha gets back and punches it to the off side.
Too full and wide outside off, Chamu leaves it for the keeper.
FOUR! Classical drive! Full ball outside off, Chamu strides forward and drives it down the ground for a glorious boundary.
Wagner from around the wicket serves a full ball on middle and off, Chamu off his front foot pushes it to covers.
That was a perfect yorker. Ervine blocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Cut away! Short and wide outside off, Craig stays back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Southee bends a bit and angles a length ball. Ervine stays tall and defends it to covers.
Fuller ball on the pads, tucks it through square leg for a brace. Sweetly timed that.
Southee from around the wicket bowls a length ball outside off, Ervine is not poking those anymore after a dropped chance to his name.
Hurls a length ball outside off, left alone.
Serves it full on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Angles in a length ball, worked off his pads to mid-wicket.
Full ball outside off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Driven! Fuller ball on middle and leg, Chamu pushes it gently through mid on for a boundary. Neat work there by the Zimbabwean opener.
Another full ball on off, Chamu strides forward and defends it to the off side.
A full ball on off, pushed to covers.

Dropped!  Hurls a back of a length ball outside off, Ervine tries to punch it away but gets a nick on it. The bounce got heavy on him and it flew to first slip. Taylor fails to grab it and a brace is taken as it goes to third man. That should have been taken. Ervine survives.
A good length ball on off, Ervine lets it through.
Hurls a length ball on off, it goes off the outside towards covers.
A good length ball on middle and leg, defended in front of the track.
Hurls a length ball outside off, Ervine sees it go back to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Short ball wide outside off, cut to point.
Another full ball on off, blocked to covers.
Full ball on middle and off, defended off his front foot to covers.
Full ball wide outside off, another loose ball but gets beaten.
Short and wide outside off, Chamu tries to drive it away from his body. Lucky to not nick it. He should focus more after all those efforts and not play loose shots.
Angles in a full ball from wide outside the crease. Ervine in time flicks it fine leg for a single.
Full and accurate on the stumps. Chamu solidly defends it into the track.
Angles in a full ball on the pads, Chamu whips it off the leg  side.
Tad fuller on off, Chibhabha gets forward and drives it on the up to mid off.
Serves it short yet again outside off, Chamu gets back and cuts it to covers.
Back of a length ball outside off, Chamu of his back foot punches it to mid off.
Short and wide outside off, Chamu lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller on middle, driven straight to mid on.
Touch full and outside off, pushed towards point by Chibhabha. He sets off for a single and there is a shy at the striker's end. It misses and they take a single in the end.
Wagner bangs it short on middle, double C ducks to let that one sail over him to Watling.
In the channel outside off, it's benn left alone.
On a length and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Chibhabha shoulders his arms to that one.

Not out! Serves it full ball on off, Ervine brings in his bat in time to block. The ball goes of the outside towards covers. The fielding side is asking questions for a catch. The umpires are checking upstairs if it was bumped or was a clean catch. The replays show that it hit the ground before it was taken by the cover fielder.
The appeal is refereed upstairs to see if the ball is bumped or is it a clean catch? Let's see...
Another full ball wide outside off, the left-hander leaves it for the keeper.
Hurls it full and wide outside off yet again. Craig sees it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Serves it full and wide outside off, Ervine sees it through to the keeper.
On the pads, played to the leg side.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Hurls a length ball on middle and leg, Ervine strides forward and blocks it.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Full ball on off, Ervine plays it with soft hands to mid on.
Craig Ervine is the new man in.

OUT! The ploy of bowling outside off has worked! Full ball wide outside off, Raza goes for a drive on the up. The ball goes off the outside edge towards gully and the birthday boy, Williamson takes it with glee. Another wicket down.
Full ball outside off, too wide actually. Raza lets it through.
Fuller ball outside off, it was a nothing delivery. Raza strides forward and pushes it to covers.
Drinks are on the field...
Another full ball on middle and leg, Chamu awkwardly defends it.
Angles in a full ball from wide outside the crease, Chibhabha off his front foot blocks it.
Down the leg side, Chamu tries to flick it but misses.
length ball on middle and off, Chamu gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it to covers.
Full ball on off, pushed to covers.
Tim Southee is the only one who has picked up a wicket, can he get one more in this new spell?
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Serves it on off, defended into the ground.
That was a close shave! Hurls a length ball outside off, angling away form  the right-hander. Raza looks to poke at it but is undone yet again.
Serves it fuller outside off, Raza drives it to mid off.
Maiden Test fifty for Chamu Chibhabha!
On the pads, it is worked to the mid-wicket for a single. That will bring up his maiden fifty. Chamu, you beauty.
Hurls a length ball outside off, Chamu strides forward and blocks it neatly.
Similar ball and Raza bunts it back to the bowler.
Boult from around the wicket serves a length ball outside off, Raza off his back foot defends it to covers.
Angles in a length ball outside off, Raza sees it and lets it through.
That was a perfect yorker. Raza does well to drill that to covers.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Length ball on off, played to covers.
FOUR! Edged and runs! Short ball outside off, Chamu looks to cut it through covers but the ball catches an outside edge which flies over the slip cordon for another boundary.
FOUR! That was played fine! Fuller ball on the pads, Chamu flicks it through long leg for a racy boundary.

Fuller ball on middle and leg, Chamu stays back and looks to flick it to the leg side but misses. The appeal for lbw is on. Maybe the ball was pitched outside leg and that's why was turned down by the umpire.
Bowls it short and wide outside off, Chamu stays back and bunts it to the cover protection.
Serves it full on off, driven to the off side.
Length ball on off, angling away. Chamu strides forward and defends it to covers.
Yorker on middle, Raza does well to keep it at bay.
Full and serves wide outside off, Raza leaves it for Watling.

That's hit hard! Bowls a short of a length delivery on middle, doesn't rise much as Raza ducks to evade it. The ball hits him on the shoulder and pops back to the keeper. They appeal for an lbw but it's not given.
Full and wide outside off, it's been left alone.
Good length ball on off, defended off the front foot gently.
On a length and around off, Raza opens the face of the bat and steers it towards backward point for a couple.
Back of a length ball on off, driven to mid off.
Similar ball outside off, Chamu kneels to drive it but is beaten yet again.
It is bowled outside off, it lures the batsman for a drive and beats him.
That's a poor line as it is serves down the leg side. Left alone by Chamu.
Serves it fuller on off, Chamu gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it to covers.
Tad short on middle and leg, Chamu stays tall and chips it to square leg.
Neil Wagner to bowl next.
On middle and off, Raza off his front foot plays it to covers.
On the pads, pushed back to Boult.
Half-volley on off, driven to covers. Missed an opportunity there for scoring some runs.
Tad short and wide outside off, Raza stays deep and cuts it to covers.
Another away movement ball outside off, Raza tries to play it but is beaten.
Beaten! Hurls a full ball wide outside off, Raza off his front foot gets beaten while looks to poke at it.
Much fuller and it comes in after pitching. Chamu stays tall and plays it with the full face of the bat through mid on. They get a brace for such a shot. Good intent by this Zimbabwean opener so far.
Fuller ball on off, driven through covers and they cross for a quick single.
Hurls a length ball outside off, Raza sees it well and shoulders his arms.
Serves it full and wide outside off, Raza tamely pushes it to covers.
Angles in a full ball from wide outside the crease. Chamu stays tall and chips it to square leg for a single.
Tad short and wide outside off, Chamu punches it through covers off his back foot for a brace. Good solid resistance by Chibhabha.
Angles in a full ball on middle and off, Raza off his front foot pushes it to mid off.
Serves it on the pads, Raza pushes it to the leg side.
Full ball on the pads, it is chipped to square leg for a single.
Short ball on middle and off, Chamu off his back foot looks to pull it but misses.
On the pads, played to mid on.
Length ball outside off, Chamu leaves it for the keeper.
Sikandar Raza is the new man in.

OUT! The Kiwis got the belated wicket! Length ball outside off, it holds its line. Tino off his front foot looks to leave it but is late and the ball hits the inside half of the bat. The ball is dragged onto the stumps and Mawoyo has to go back after all that efforts. It is Southee who has provided the much-needed breakthrough.
Length ball on off, defended off his front foot.
Serves it tad short on the pads, Tino shuffles across and  tries to tuck it to the the leg side but it goes off his thigh pads.
Back of a length ball outside off, am easy leave for the Rhodesian opener.
Serves it full on off, angling in. Tino off his front foot strides forward and defends it with soft hands.
Length ball outside off, it holds its line and goes straight. Tino sees it and lets it through.
Boult from around the wicket, serves it fuller on middle and leg, Chamu drives it to mid off.
Angling in a full ball on the pads, pushed to the leg side.
Tad short and wide outside off, a back foot punch to covers on that occasion.
A length ball outside off, angling away. Chamu strides ahead and miscues it back to the bowler.
Serves it full and outside off, Chamu sees it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Length ball outside off, Chamu steps up and plays it to covers.
FOUR! Juicy full toss and it is dealt with ease! Full toss on middle and leg, Tino pushes it with soft hands down the ground for a racy boundary. Easy pickings there.
Another bouncer and Chamu leaves it well this time.
Similar ball and it is defended to covers.
Fuller ball on off, angling in, good mix up of variations here. Tino strides ahead and plays it to covers.
Short and it's well directed over the batsman' s head. Tino was not aware of it and ducks down at the end. The batsman falls after that awkward stance.
Serves it fuller on middle and leg, Tino gets ahead and pushes it to mid on.
On the pads, Boult is bowling in with full pace and good angle. Chamu is determined too and plays it with soft hands to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, it holds its line. Chamu presses forward and plays it to covers.
Hurls a length ball on middle and leg, played to mid-wicket.
Tad short and wide outside off, it is cut to point. The fielder fumbles it for a single..
Tad fuller on middle and leg, Mawoyo flicks it to the leg side.
Serves it full outside off, angling in after pitching. Tino strides forward and defends it to the off side.
FOUR! First boundary of the day! Hurls it on the pads, Chibhabha moves across and flicks it through backward square leg to pick up a boundary. Good use of the wrists there.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Chibhabha lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper.
Good length delivery on off, shoulders arms to it.
Strays on the pads, Mawoyo works it towards fine leg for a single. That ends the run of 6 consecutive maidens.
Angles a length delivery on middle, flicked toward the mid-wicket.
On a length and around middle, defended back to the bowler.
TIM SOUTHEE to bowl from the other end!
Serves it full on middle, bunted back to Trent.
Short and wide outside off, a play and a miss.
Full ball on middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Hurls it fuller on the stumps, played back to the bowler.
Angles in a length ball into the pads. Chamu goes for a flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and the fielding side ask the questions for lbw. The appeal is turned down.
Length ball outside off, swinging away. Chamu leaves it for the keeper.

We are back for the cricketing action. The two overnight batsmen will continue to bat. Tino Mawoyo and Chamu Chibhabha are the crease. Chamu Chibhabha will take the strike. Trent Boult will bowl at him. Here we go...

In response, the Zimbabwean openers dealt last session on day 2 with ease and frustrated the Kiwi bowlers by not giving away any wickets. Will they show the same resistance and zeal to go miles? Or will we get to see tumble of wickets straightaway? Do join us in a while for the game.

Hello and a warm welcome for Day 3 of this 2nd Test between Zimbabwe and New Zealand. So far the first 2 days have been in the favour of the visiting side where they have displayed a run feast. The Kiwis have scored a gigantic score for the home side.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

Right then! The hosts have shown the stomach to fight but can they continue to dig in and dig big tomorrow? Well, that remains to be seen. We hope that the fighting contest continues and also hope to have you all on board tomorrow at 1300 IST. Until next time, take care and goodbye! Cheers!

New Zealand will take this as their day but would have liked a wicket or two in their kitty as well. Earlier in the day, starting with Kane Williamson, Ross Taylor and BJ Watling got to their back-to-back tons and fifties respectively and amassed their side to a grand total which also happens to be their best against Zimbabwe in this format.

Off goes the bails and off trudge the two Zimbabweans openers who have done a terrific job! After being toiled for a day and a half and having a mammoth target in front of them, the home side showed high levels of patience as they have not only managed to see off the new ball, but also the lethal Kiwi pace attack. Though Mawoyo and Chibhabha started very slow, they picked up the pace towards the end.
Full and way outside off, Tino Mawoyo opens the face of the bat and steers it to point. Dot ball and that's the end of the over. THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 2!

HUGE LBW APPEAL! But it's turned down. Full and fired in on leg, shaping and it's angling down, Mawoyo is struck low on the pads as he tries flicking this away. Southee turns and screams, appealing for a leg before. The umpire isn't interested one bit. Replays confirm why, it was always going down leg. Good decision.
Southee pitches it up this time, varying the length here, Tino comes forward to play at it but ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
Again, it's a on a good length, outside off, it's quite harmless though. No trouble for the batsman to leave it alone.
Length ball outside off, the batsman has nothing to do with that.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mawoyo opens the face of the bat and steers it to point.
This will be the last over of the day.
On the stumps once more, Chamu gets behind the line and blocks it to the on side.
Full and aimed at the stumps, Chibhabha presses ahead and dead-bats this one. Solid.
Another flighted ball outside off, Sodhi doing well to pitch it up, being brave here, it's hit to the left of short cover, not well enough though.
Looped up and pitched around off, drilled to short cover.
Sodhi really got away with that one. Flat and short around off, Chibhabha goes back and pulls this away hard. It's straight to the man at wide mid on, though. Should have found the fence, really.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Chamu drives it to the man at cover.
Fullish and aimed at the stumps, the batsman presents a tight defensive shot. Goes off the inside edge to square leg. Dot ball to end the over.

That went right through. And kept a little low as well. Length ball in the corridor outside off, the ball skids off the surface a bit as Tino looks to get his bat down in time. It goes right between bat and pad and behind to the keeper. Could have easily kissed the off pole. The opener should consider himself lucky there.
Length delivery outside off, a lot of width on offer and it's begging to be hit. Mawoyo stays back and looks to cut this away... Doesn't get any connection on it, though. Another missed opportunity.
Very full and quite outside the off stump, Tino doesn't bother himself with it.
Short of a length delivery around off, nipping in heavily, Mawoyo hops a little and fends it to the on side.
Southee steaming in, bowls a length ball outside off, no shot offered to this one.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Short and wide outside off, cut to cover-point.
Nicely tossed up around off, good flight on that from the leggie, Chamu presses forward and keeps it out.
A little shorter once more, it's played to point for no run.
Touch short outside off, Chibhabha goes on his back foot and cuts it to extra cover.
Floated up on middle and off, Chibhabha prods forward, gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Good length ball outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
The keeper goes back again for the last ball of the over...

FOUR BYES! Amazing movement and great shape on that. Pitched on a length and around off, straightening up first and then going slightly away from the batsman. It goes past the outside edge and there's late movement on that which gets the keeper in a pickle. He is unable to collect it and the ball races away behind to the boundary line.
Pitches it up this time Southee, it's defended well off the front foot to the off side.
The keeper is right up to the stumps now...
Length ball just outside off, nipping in a bit, it's kept out well off the back foot.
Fuller in length and outside off, good live and good shape there, Mawoyo prods forward and gracefully shoulders his arms to it.
On a length and going down leg, Mawoyo looks to nudge it away but misses as the ball brushes off his thigh pad. There are appeals for a caught behind but the umpire rightly turns it down.
TIM SOUTHEE is back on.

FOUR! Doesn't miss this one, gives it the desired treatment. A half-tracker around off, Chamu rocks back in a flash, gets himself into position quickly and hammers the pull through mid-wicket to pick up a boundary.

He's missed that! Could have hit it anywhere on the off side, really missed on. Looped up outside off, some nice air, real nice air given to it by Sodhi, Chibhabha gets down and goes for the slog sweep but misses it. Could have taken it on the full as well.
Tossed up around off, a little too full actually as Chamu digs it out to short cover.
Still giving it some good flight, it's driven to mid off as it's bowled around off.
Pushed slightly quicker through the air, length dragged back a bit as well, a leg spinner, Chibhabha gets back and buries it into the ground.
Full on the stumps, driven down to mid on for nothing.
Quite full on off stump, CC makes good use of his wrists and turns it against the spin through the unmanned mid-wicket region. Gets a single easily.
Drags the length back this time, on middle and off, Tino gets back and whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, full again, driven straight to the man at cover once more.
Fullish and some nice flight given to it by Santner, it's driven down to mid off for a quick run.
Loopy and full outside off, Chibhabha once again plays the cover drive. It's hit hard but it bounces right off the man at silly point. No chance he could have caught that.

FOUR! Oh, what a lovely stroke! Beautiful. Tossed up delivery just outside off, Chibhabha leans into the drive and creams it ever so well through the covers. Gets it through the gap and away to the boundary line.
Once again, it's driven to covers for no run and that's the end of the over.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Full around off, driven to covers for nothing.
Loopy leg spinner outside off, Tino is beaten as he looks to poke at it.
Flatter and shorter around off, Chamu's missed an opportunity here, should have dispatched that. Only manages to find the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Runs to the other end for a single.
Sodhi with a high full toss to start things off with. Around off as Chamu steps out and punches it to covers.
ISH SODHI into the attack!

FOUR! THIRD BOUNDARY OF THE OVER! Flighted delivery on middle, Mawoyo is ready for this. Quickly kneels down and sweeps it square on the leg side. Nobody there for protection and that'll run away to the fence.
Floats this up well outside off, left alone.

That's actually well played by the right-hander. Some good air given to it by the spinner, Mawoyo initially was going to get forward to drive it, but in the end decides to rock back and just gently taps it in front of silly point.
Some nice flight provided by Mitchell, it's outside off as Tino cuts this away to backward point. Will get no run for it, though.
FOUR! BACK-TO-BACK BOUNDARIES! Well, talk about bumping it up a notch. Fullish on the stumps, Mawoyo gets down to this one and sweeps it well to send it across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Now Mawoyo joins in on the action! Nicely looped up and pitched full outside off, Tino leans forward and crisply drives this through the covers for his first boundary of the innings.
Way down the leg side, short of a length again, left alone by the batsman.

FOUR! A BOUNDARY! Is this real? This is not a drill. You read that right. On a length and outside off, Chamu Chibhabha hangs back and cuts this through point to send it all the way to the fence. Played that with style too. Lovely shot.
Angled in short from wide outside the crease, Chibhabha does well to tap it to the off side after going back.

Managed to evade the infielders there. Got to say the placement was impeccable too. Short of a length and angling in to the body of the batsman, he manages to rise on top of the bounce and turn it past the short leg fielders towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery around off, angling in sharply, kept out well off the back foot.

Neil from around the wicket, relaly bending his back into it again, bangs it in hard and it's a shortish delivery which is angling in to the batsman, Tino does well to get behind the line and tap it down into the track.
Straying on the pads, it's nudged fine down the leg as the batsmen take a couple of easy runs.
Keeps it on the shorter side once more, it's well outside off, hit straight to cover-point.
Shorter in length and pitched outside off, Chibhabha looks to smash this through the covers but unfortunate for him that he finds the fielder positioned there.
Slower one this time, loops it up nicely outside off, tapped away for no run.
Almost a yorker this one, pushed a little quicker through the air as Chamu digs it back out in the direction of the bowler.
Santner comes around the wicket, floats this up nicely around off, it's driven back to the bowler.
Short of a length around off, blocked off the back foot.
Comes from around the wicket here, another one which is on the shorter side, Mawoyo has no clue about this. He tries to fend it away and ends up playing it in front of forward short leg.
Think he's got the entire team around the batsman. Everybody is swarming around him.
Back of a length and angled across the batsman, Tino stays back and punches it straight to the man at short cover.
Pitches it up this time, on a length on middle and leg, kept out well off the back foot.
Beautiful! Another sharp bouncer on middle and leg, it goes off the deck hard as Tino ducks. Wagner once again giving it his all here.
Wagner charging in, and as always, starts off with a bouncer. He bangs it in short and and around off, Mawoyo does keep to keep it down.
Floated ball around middle, defended off the front foot watchfully.
Drops it short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Nicely flighted ball around off, turning away after pitching. Chibhabha looks to push it to the off side but gets beaten by the turn.
Outside off, driven towards covers.
Loopy ball around off, blocked off the front foot.
Full and around off, pushed back to Santner.
Short of a length delivery down the leg side, left alone.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Mawoyo with a straight bat.
Fuller length delivery on off, Mawoyo defends it off the front foot watchfully.
On the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Another short ball on middle, Chibhabha gets on the toes and defends it down.
Short of a length ball on middle, Chibhabha defends it off the back foot.
Outside off, Tino gets back and pushes it towards point.
FOUR! Dead straight! Fuller delivery on the pads, Mawoyo clears his front leg and drives it dead straight just past mid on for a boundary.
Floated ball around off, driven towards mid off.
Loopy delivery around off, defended gently off the front foot.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards point.
Full and flighted ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Short of a length delivery, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Chibhabha fends it away on the off side.
Good length delivery on middle, defended off the back foot.
Banged on middle, Chibhabha lets it go.
Drinks time!
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Fires a full ball outside off, Mawoyo shoulders his arms.
Landed outside off, defended watchfully.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.

In the air... safe! Flighted ball around off, Chibhabha sits down and looks to go over the top. He mistimes it high in the air over mid off and the fielder running backwards to take it couldn't get underneath it in time. Only a single taken.
Tossed up around off, pushed towards covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Shortish on middle, Chibhabha pulls it over the man at short leg for a single.
Another short ball on middle, Chibhabha once again ducks under it.
Banged short on middle, Chibhabha does well to evade it.
Fuller on off, driven through covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery on off, Mawoyo taps it towards covers and wanted to cross over immediately. He is sent back in time by his partner.
NEIL WAGNER into the attack now!
Drops it short on off, punched hard but finds the fielder at covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy ball around off, Chibhabha prods forward and guides it with an opened face bat past first slip for a couple.
Short and outside off, punched towards short covers.
Tossed up around middle, turning away. Chibhabha comes forward to defend but the ball turns away and he gets beaten.
Full and around off, defended off the front foot.
MITCHELL SANTNER into the attack!
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a short ball on middle. Tino defends it down.
Short of a length ball on middle, Mawoyo ducks under it.
Fuller ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Fuller length ball on off, Mawoyo looks to drive but gets an inside edge on the pads.
The batsman shows full face of the bat.
Fuller length delivery on off, Mawoyo defends it off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, defended towards covers.
Comes from around the wicket...
CC shoulders arms to let that one through.
On a length and around off, defended with a straight bat.
Good length ball on off, CC looks to cut but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Good length delivery on middle, defended by covering the line.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Chibhabha looks to drive but gets beaten.
Still slightly on the shorter side, Tino keeps this one out well with a straight bat. Superb over from Tim Southee comes to an end.
Southee is changing it up here nicely. Comes out with another bouncer, somewhat taking Tino by surprise. He does well though to crouch low and evade it.
Pitches it up this time, a fuller delivery which is clipped off the pads. Played to mid-wicket for no run.
Southee with another bouncer, on middle and leg, the batsman ducks under it well to let it sail over him.
Shortish and slightly going down leg, no shot is offered as the ball goes off the body and past the diving keeper. No runs will be given as no shot was offered. Dead ball signalled by the umpire.

Southee comes steaming in, hits the deck hard as he bangs this one in short. It's well directed and very sharpy. Mawoyo leans back but the ball is too quick on him, hits him around the shoulder and flies back towards the slip cordon.
Tad short around off, it's kept out off the back foot.

This is on a length, on middle and leg, Chibhabha steps across a bit and flicks it towards short mid-wicket. Martin Guptill there is quick on his toes, though. He charges to his right and dives to collect the ball. Saves a run for his side. Top stuff.
Boult once again bangs this in short, it's sharp and around off, Chamu gets on top of the bounce and taps it down into the ground on the off side.
Shortish on the body, Mawoyo rises and taps it down on the leg side and takes a quick single.
Good length ball outside off, the batsman lifts his bat and lets it go through to Watling.
Mawoyo shoulders arms to let that one through.
Good length and strayed on the pads, Chibhabha looks to flick but misses.
Full length delivery outside off, riven towards covers.

Another short ball outside off by Southee, it rises off the deck and surprises Chibhabha all of a sudden. He hops to defend but the ball catches the shoulder of the bat and pops up and goes safe through gully and third slip. A couple taken.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Chibhabha pulls it behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Short of a length delivery on off, Chibhabha hops in the crease and fends it away on the off side.
Good length ball on middle, defended off the back foot nicely.
On a length and outside off, Mawoyo steers it towards point.
Good length ball outside off, punched towards covers.
In the channel outside off, Mawoyo lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper.
Short of a length ball on off, Chibhabha swivels and looks to pull but the ball suddenly rises off the deck and he mistimes it towards mid on for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Off the mark are the home side! Back of a length delivery outside off, a tinge of width was given. Chibhabha gets back and punches it through the gap at covers to pick up the first boundary.
Fuller length delivery on off, defended off the front foot.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Mawoyo does well to evade it.
Good length delivery on middle, defended off the back foot gently.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Mawoyo ducks to evade it.
Full and down the leg side, Mawoyo looks to flick but misses.
Good length delivery outside off, Mawoyo leaves it for the keeper.
Comes around the wicket, double C defends it off the front foot. 24 balls gone and Zimbabwe are still not off the mark.
Good length delivery on the pads, Chibhabha flicks it towards square leg.
Full length delivery on off, Chibhabha defends it off the front foot.
On a length and around off, Chibhabha looks to poke at it but the ball shapes away a touch and he gets beaten.
In the corridor outside off, Chibhabha shoulders his arms.
Tad full and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Fuller length delivery on middle, defended towards the man at mid on. Three consecutive maidens!
Banged in short on off, Mawoyo arches back and lets it go.
Outside off, left alone.
Mawoyo shoulders arms to let that one through.
Angles a length delivery on middle, Mawoyo looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
On a length and outside off, defended off the back foot.
Good length delivery on middle, answered with a straight bat.
In the channel outside off, CC has got nothing to offer on that one.
On a length and around off, curls in after pitching. Chibhabha prods forward to flick but it goes off the inside edge towards the on side.
Good length ball on off, straightens a bit after pitching. Chibhabha shoulders his arms to it.
Short and outside off, Chamu looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards covers.
Starts with a full length delivery, shaping away a bit. Chibhabha makes an easy leave to the keeper.
TRENT BOULT will share the new cherry from the other end!
On a length and outside off, Mawoyo lifts his bat and lets it go through to the keeper.
Good length ball on middle, Mawoyo defends it off the back foot.
Full and on middle and leg, Mawoyo looks to flick it across the line but once again gets an inside edge but this time on the left boot.

A loud shout for lbw, turned down! On a length and angling in, Mawoyo looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Southee appeals for an lbw but the umpire says there was an inside edge there. Replays confirm the same.
Angles a length delivery on the pads, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Starts with a length delivery down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone.
